dcterms:description: Dex-Net 2.0 is a large-scale simulated dataset for parallel-gripper grasping, containing 6.7 million grasps on pre-rendered depth images of 3D models. The dataset includes grasp labels acquired via random sampling of antipodal grasp candidates, with a heuristic-based approach used to compute a robustness metric.
dcterms:title: Dex-Net 2.0
